name: TWDB completed-survey packages: elevation-area-capacity .txt + conservation-pool polygon + contours (fetched by HTTP range from the zips)
dataType: area-capacity table at 0.1 ft; pool polygon; 1/2/5-ft contours
lakeCoverage: 91 surveys with table+zip, 68 with a pool polygon matched to the table area (63 used, >=250 ac and S3<0.9); 18 contour layers rebuilt as 15 m depth rasters
reason: validation truth for lake-level S3/S6/S10/rel_per_ft and for spatial tests; contour TIN reproduces table S3 within 0.005 on 15 of 18 lakes. Range reads of zip members avoid the 0.4-1.9 GB downloads

name: waterdatafortexas.org reservoir daily level (individual/<slug>.csv)
dataType: daily water level, surface area, storage
lakeCoverage: Fork, Tawakoni, Brownwood, Lavon, Cedar Creek used (slug known for 11 tested; hubbard-creek 404)
reason: daily level pairs Landsat scenes with the pool level; level history since 1979 for Fork

name: Minnesota DNR Lake Bathymetric Contours / Outline (MapServer water_lake_bathymetry layers 0,1)
dataType: depth contour lines (5 or 10 ft interval) + outline polygon, by DOW lake number
lakeCoverage: 9 of 14 MN directory lakes matched by name (Vermilion not found)
reason: exact only at the contour depths (first contour 5 or 10 ft): fine for <=10 ft shares, not for <=3 ft; also has a DEM raster layer (id 3) and a littoral-zone FeatureServer (not used)

name: USGS 3DEP seamless DEM ImageServer getSamples
dataType: elevation samples (1 m lidar where available)
lakeCoverage: 33 CWMS + 63 TWDB + 9 MN lakes at 600 pts x 10 offsets; 27 lakes at 150 m spacing x 7 offsets; 242+ fleet lakes at 400 pts x 2 offsets
reason: service is latency-bound (about 7 s per request regardless of size); concurrent requests (6-8) scale linearly up to a point then slow down; 5 AK lakes had no DEM at some points

name: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 (L5/7/8/9) on Microsoft Planetary Computer, STAC + COG windows
lakeCoverage: 5 TX lakes, 2000-2026, 744-834 scenes read per lake, 224-430 used
reason: water mask MNDWI>0 with QA cloud/shadow/fill mask; usable for drawdown-exposure hypsometry; 30 m pixels bias shallow shares low

name: NOAA NGS NCAT / VERTCON 3.0 llh API
dataType: NGVD29 -> NAVD88 vertical datum shift at lat/lon
reason: shift median abs 0.64 ft, up to 5.4 ft; sigma 0.07 m reported; no coverage for LOCAL / utility datums

name: USACE CWMS Data API timeseries + catalog; Access2Water location records (vertical_datum, tsid)
dataType: daily/hourly pool elevation series; per-project vertical datum
lakeCoverage: 213 of 417 bound lakes returned a 2016-2026 series (CWMS 60/64, Access2Water 81/112 via CWMS tsid, NWPS/HADS cached 33/41)
reason: operating-range source; Access2Water vertical_datum for 613 projects: NGVD29 456, LOCAL 94, NAVD88 38, unrecorded 25

name: USGS NWIS daily values, parameters 62614/62615/00062
lakeCoverage: 33 of 79 bound USGS lakes gave a series
reason: 62614 = NGVD29, 62615 = NAVD88, 00062 datum per site; 46 USGS lakes had no daily-mean elevation (gage height sites need the site datum)

name: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 static layers (prior thread, gsw_features.json)
lakeCoverage: 11 CWMS lakes in the SE tile
reason: fluctuating-share Spearman -0.70 vs CWMS rel-per-foot (n=11): a long drawdown on a steep lake looks like a wide flat. Landsat masks used instead; JRC monthly history is Earth Engine only (not reachable here)

question: 3DEP shoreline-slope proxy: lake-level ranking

numbers: CWMS within x2 85 %, TWDB within x2 65 % vs constant 87 %

question: Share of lake surface within 3/6/10 ft
finding: proxy adds nothing to a constant after calibration

question: Lake classification broad-shallow (top third)
finding: AUC 0.85 / accuracy 82 % on CWMS rel-per-foot; AUC 0.69 / 68 % on TWDB S3 (all-no baseline 67 %)
numbers: P_dem vs perimeter/area AUC 0.69 vs 0.68 on Texas

question: Per-segment slope vs where the shallows are
finding: weak but right-signed: mean Spearman -0.29 TX, -0.16 MN; top-third AUC 0.69/0.62; slope-gated flat mask IoU 0.28 vs 0.29 for the plain 100 m shore band

question: Longer slope profiles (30-100, 60-200 m, rise at 200 m)
finding: no improvement; 60-200 m slope has the wrong sign within lakes
numbers: CWMS Spearman 0.71/0.70 vs 0.77, calibration x2 high

question: Landsat drawdown-exposure hypsometry
finding: best bathymetry-free within-lake signal: per-pixel threshold elevation vs TWDB contour depth Spearman 0.87-0.93 on 4 of 5 lakes (Fork 0.58), MAE 0.4-1.4 ft; distance-to-shore 0.22-0.54; lake-wide dA/dz and S3 biased low
numbers: recall of in-range cells 24-75 %, <=3 ft cells recovered about 47-53 % on 3 lakes

question: Contour interval vs depth error
finding: rebuild from every 5th/10th 1-ft contour: RMSE 1.30/2.81 ft, bias -0.51/-1.63 ft; 2-ft: 0.28 ft

question: JRC occurrence
finding: wrong sign vs measured area change per foot
